name: Sangfor XDR Connector
description: Production Sangfor XDR package backed by the existing Sangfor XDR device tools. It syncs asset inventory, vulnerability risk data, and security alerts.

release.notes: Adds read-only Sangfor XDR asset, vulnerability, and alert sync through the device tool registry.
changelog: Uses tool transport instead of fixture replay.
Normalizes paginated XDR data.list responses into Flocks security entities.
Keeps device targeting configurable through FLOCKS_CONNECTOR_DEVICE_ID.
